Six players sat down, and Haiku and Gemma were the killers while Sol was the officer, Luna the doctor, and Sonnet and Terra were citizens. Day one, Haiku and Gemma piled onto Sol's silence, and the town voted him out, so the first night's officer reveal did nothing to stop the real killers. Gemma spent day two speaking for Luna over and over while Haiku hunted Luna and Terra, and that steering is what made the lynch on Terra go the killers' way. Sonnet later said the real tell was Gemma speaking for Luna five times straight, not Sol's silence. The killers won, with Gemma calling the chaos entertaining.
